gen-dafont-quantum-gf-heebo: Heebo stands tall in the middle of each line, its curves stopping short of closing up. Quantum, the tech-flavored display face, spreads its letters loose and keeps its strokes free of any swelling.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur is a modern sans-serif with tall lowercase forms and curves that leave wide gaps before the stems. Quantum, the display heading, sits above it.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-hind-madurai: Wide-mouthed and tidy, Hind Madurai fills the line with lowercase that stands nearly as tall as capitals, its s curves flung open. Quantum above it stays loose and light.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-hind-mysuru: Tight to the top and no-nonsense, Hind Mysuru keeps its lowercase pressed near ascender height, each a left slightly ajar. And Quantum, the display heading, adds loose spacing and a compressed reach.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-hind-siliguri: Quantum's loose letterfit and open-mouthed shapes give it a spare, techy look, drawn with lots of room around each letter. Hind Siliguri hums along below in a constant line weight.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-hind-vadodara: Spacious and crisp, Quantum leads with loose letterfit. Hind Vadodara follows with big, tall-bowled e and a, though shrinking the heading would waste Quantum's open spacing.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-huninn: Loose letterfit with generous breathing space is Quantum's signature, and its open shapes give a clean tech edge. But Huninn does the steady work, with lowercase rising near cap height and crossbars as fat as the stems.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-karla: Quantum draws its heading like bent cable, with no swelling or thinning. Karla is the workhorse, a gaping c and a middle band so tall the line looks stocky.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-kedebideri: Quantum brings a steel-cable outline with no thick-thin shift, loose and techy up top. Kedebideri then carries the text with a skyward x-height and rounded letters that stay open, so paragraphs feel inviting.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-khula: Rope-thin and loose, Quantum draws its heading in an outline with no thick or thin parts, then hands off to Khula. Khula's tall midsection and open curves keep a long passage feeling easy.
